messages:
leo_sales: Hi all - Rachel from Meridian Health asks whether we can do end-to-end mTLS and keep original client IPs when using PrivateLink across two AWS accounts. They want to avoid a VPN/DX if possible and need rough pricing impact.

maria_neteng: Quick summary: Cross-account PrivateLink is possible. Two viable patterns: 1) TCP passthrough NLB (TLS passthrough) so backend validates client certs and sees client IPs (use NLB target type=ip). 2) Terminate mTLS at our ingress proxy and forward X-Forwarded-For to preserve original IP in logs. Pattern 1 preserves L3 src in sockets more directly; Pattern 2 gives more control (OCSP, revocation) but moves cert validation to the proxy.

sam_sre: Note on caveats: AWS ENI semantics can vary; recommend a short validation during POC. Also PrivateLink consumer pays AWS endpoint hourly + data processing. On the Redwood side, if we need dedicated NLBs or reserved infra for cross-account routing we typically add a modest infra premium and a small integration fee.

rachel_client: For compliance we need individual originating IPs in SIEM and must perform OCSP checks for client certs. If we use Pattern 1, will OCSP reachability be an issue?

maria_neteng: If Pattern 1, OCSP/CRL is the app's responsibility; ensure your backend can reach your OCSP responder from the subnet. If you can't, Pattern 2 allows Redwood to perform OCSP/CRL at the proxy and integrate with your revocation API. We'll document cert rotation and revocation SLAs.

leo_sales: Action items: Maria - produce a 1-page diagram for Pattern 1 vs 2 and bullet pricing deltas. Sam - schedule 2-hour POC test window and a small test plan. Rachel - confirm POC times. Ops-bot: provision a short-lived test VPC if needed.

ops-bot: Test env requested: redwood-poc-meridian-2026 ready (uploader: ops-bot).

rachel_client: Wednesday afternoon works for POC. Please include sample openssl and curl commands for verifying client IP and mTLS.

maria_neteng: Will include snippet examples and will call out expected AWS charges + estimated Redwood add-ons.

leo_sales: Thanks team, I'll update the SOW draft once pricing is in. Keeping thread open for follow-up.
